events.title: Bruce Peninsula National Park
events.thought: Into Bruce Peninsula National Park — one of Canada's most dramatic landscapes.
events.photoCaption: Parks Canada entrance sign for Bruce Peninsula National Park of Canada.

events.title: Niagara Escarpment Cliffs, Bruce Peninsula
events.thought: These sheer dolomite cliffs over Georgian Bay might be the most dramatic thing I've seen so far on this trip.
events.photoCaption: Sheer dolomite cliffs of Bruce Peninsula drop into the turquoise waters of Georgian Bay.

events.title: Chi-Cheemaun Ferry, Tobermory
events.thought: Boarding the Chi-Cheemaun to cross Georgian Bay — the 'Big Canoe' lives up to its name.
events.photoCaption: The Chi-Cheemaun Ontario ferry, adorned with Indigenous artwork, prepares to cross Georgian Bay.
